bull.b: Sustained high growth alongside rising customer adoption, use cases, and ARPU indicates strong platform expansion. Broader product usage can deepen enterprise relationships, support retention, and create durable upsell opportunities.

Strong operating cash generation and expanding adjusted margins provide funding for product investment, acquisitions, and debt management. Improving cash conversion also increases resilience as Zeta scales toward more consistent profitability.

A large proprietary data asset, long model-tuning history, and rising AI adoption can strengthen targeting and optimization. Higher retention among AI users supports durable differentiation, deeper platform integration, and expansion of customer spend.

bear.b: Zeta has improved materially but has not yet demonstrated consistently positive GAAP earnings. Thin operating profitability leaves less room for cost increases, execution mistakes, or slower growth to be absorbed without weakening bottom-line results.

bear.t: Gross margin exposure to channel mix
bear.b: Greater exposure to agency-led social channels can dilute gross margins even when revenue grows quickly. If this mix persists, it may constrain margin expansion and reduce the amount of revenue converted into operating profit and cash.

bear.t: Growth depends partly on M&A and uncertain new sales
bear.b: A meaningful gap between reported and organic growth increases reliance on acquisitions to sustain headline expansion. Longer enterprise sales cycles for ZBI may further delay monetization, complicating execution and revenue visibility.
